entries.04065f3c9e27d05f: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,279 million (down 34.9% from the previous year), ordinary profit was ¥1,642 million (down 26.1%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥1,111 million (down 28.3%). The annual securities report cites as reasons for the decline that, even with price revisions, the price of its main raw material, eggs, stayed at unprecedentedly high levels, and that rising personnel and logistics costs could not be fully absorbed. It explains that ordinary profit includes foreign exchange gains, share of profit of equity-method investees and gains on long-term foreign exchange forward contracts, and that net income includes loss on retirement of non-current assets.

entries.794f5922f17803c3: A segment that sells foods such as egg-processed products including tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet), processed vegetable products including seasoned kanpyo (dried gourd strips) and shiitake mushrooms used as fillings for maki sushi (rolled sushi), and fish paste products including crab-flavored kamaboko, to customers that handle nakashoku (buying prepared food to eat at home or elsewhere), such as supermarkets and convenience stores. In addition to products made at its own factories, it also sells goods such as its own planned-brand products purchased from other companies, ambient foods, and frozen and chilled foods. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥46,960 million (down 0.1% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥2,564 million (down 29.8%). The securities report cites as reasons for the decline in profit a higher manufacturing cost ratio due to egg prices, the main raw material, remaining at a high level and a decrease in production of maki sushi fillings, as well as increases in personnel and logistics costs. Exports overseas exceeded the previous fiscal year.
entries.7d4951275b03b6cd: This is the segment that sells burdock tea products made from burdock root through mail order and as retail products at drugstores and elsewhere. Gobo Cha," and the chocolate-like burdock-based confections "GOVOCE" and "GOVOCE Milk." For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥4,007 million (up 11.8% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥339 million (up 58.2% from the previous fiscal year); the annual securities report gives as reasons for the sales increase that mail-order sales grew through advertising centered on TV CM and that retail products also grew.

entries.a46d43b2a0005d32: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,430 million, up 0.8% from the previous year. Business-Use Foods was about the same as the previous year, and the reason for the change is the growth of Health Food. In Business-Use Foods, domestic revenue fell below the previous year owing to lower demand for maki sushi caused by price increases in rice and seaweed, while overseas revenue exceeded the previous year. The company implemented price revisions in April 2025 and February 2026.
